description: Restore a soft-deleted entity (customer, project, task, or subtask) and all its children from the recycle bin. Requires Admin role. entity_type must be one of: Customer, Project, Task, SubTask. Refused (CONFLICT.STATE_CONFLICT, reason PARENT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN) while the customer, project or task it belongs to is still in the recycle bin - restore that one first.

entity_id.description: Id of the deleted entity to restore.

entity_type.description: Type of entity to restore. One of: Customer, Project, Task, SubTask.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

name: restore_entity
title: Restore from recycle bin
